headline: Helmut Snowfield
title: Aniimo Helmut Snowfield Form | Only Appears in Snow | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Helmut is a Dark Aniimo, and its Snowfield form is a special find. It only appears while it is snowing in Russet Highlands. Look in the woods near the Rainbow Woods teleporter. If the weather is clear, you will not find it, so wait for snow before searching. Russet Highlands is a high level area, so bring a strong team. Did you find Snowfield Helmut? Comment below!
description: Helmut's Snowfield Form in Aniimo appears only in snowy weather in Russet Highlands, near the Rainbow Woods teleporter.
